== frame static_pipeline cursor=7,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ /bin/echo ignored | cp source static-copy > static-redirecti
|on
|cp requires the original shell process and cannot run in a forked context
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo native-fs-status-$?
|native-fs-status-2
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $

@7 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
== frame dynamic_pipeline cursor=16,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ /bin/echo ignored | cp source static-copy > static-redirecti
|on
|cp requires the original shell process and cannot run in a forked context
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo native-fs-status-$?
|native-fs-status-2
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ export NATIVE_FS_COMMAND=cp
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ /bin/echo ignored | $NATIVE_FS_COMMAND source dynamic-copy >
| dynamic-redirection
|cp requires the original shell process and cannot run in a forked context
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo native-fs-status-$?
|native-fs-status-2
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $

@4 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo

@7 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 export

== frame nested_substitution cursor=23,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ /bin/echo ignored | cp source static-copy > static-redirecti
|on
|cp requires the original shell process and cannot run in a forked context
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo native-fs-status-$?
|native-fs-status-2
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ export NATIVE_FS_COMMAND=cp
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ /bin/echo ignored | $NATIVE_FS_COMMAND source dynamic-copy >
| dynamic-redirection
|cp requires the original shell process and cannot run in a forked context
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo native-fs-status-$?
|native-fs-status-2
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo "$(cp source nested-copy > nested-redirection)"
|cp requires the original shell process and cannot run in a forked context
|
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo native-fs-status-$?
|native-fs-status-0
|

== frame deep_substitution cursor=23,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ export NATIVE_FS_COMMAND=cp
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ /bin/echo ignored | $NATIVE_FS_COMMAND source dynamic-copy >
| dynamic-redirection
|cp requires the original shell process and cannot run in a forked context
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo native-fs-status-$?
|native-fs-status-2
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo "$(cp source nested-copy > nested-redirection)"
|cp requires the original shell process and cannot run in a forked context
|
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo native-fs-status-$?
|native-fs-status-0
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo "$(echo $(cp source deep-copy > deep-redirection))"
|cp requires the original shell process and cannot run in a forked context
|
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo native-fs-status-$?
|native-fs-status-0
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
